paper.title: Algorithm 837: AMD, an approximate minimum degree ordering algorithm

claim.text: Shipped reference Demo/amd_demo.out: "LDL' flop count for real A" for the built-in can_24 matrix is 647 (exact integer equality, tol 0)

values.name: LDL' flop count for real A, can_24 demo (amd_demo.out)

attempt: Reproduced. The authors' Makefiles ran unchanged (make lib in the top directory, which builds Source and then runs the Demo targets; exit 0; the demo's diff against the shipped output is empty). Two clean-directory passes of the demo binary give LDL' flop count for real A = 647, and the whole stdout of each pass is identical to the shipped Demo/amd_demo.out (sha256 63a791ae...). Exact equality with tol 0: met. No patch and no build flag. Archive note: the sha256 of 837.zip served by netlib today is d15f725a..., not the f9ae8b20... in the queue entry; the claim's own reference file (Demo/amd_demo.out) matches its registered sha256, so the claim stands. The archive-hash mismatch is reported to scout as a registration issue. Replay (G5) not yet run.
